description: **Doc summaries no longer break mid-sentence.** Soft-wrapped Go, JSDoc, and KDoc doc comments are joined at extraction so module and package summaries read as complete sentences instead of being cut at the source line wrap.
**list-modules summaries are complete sentences.** Module and package bullets now show the whole first sentence of the docstring with no 155-character cap and no truncation ellipsis.

**Feed and llms.txt summaries carry the full first paragraph.** Atom feed entry summaries (including selfblog blog feeds, which share this code path) and llms.txt page summaries now contain the complete first paragraph instead of a single truncated sentence.

**Meta descriptions are no longer truncated.** Handwritten frontmatter descriptions appear verbatim in the meta and og:description tags, and auto-extracted descriptions are the complete first sentence -- no 155-character cap and no ellipsis. The advisory SEO length lint still nudges authors toward concise descriptions.

**Removed the `list-features` directive.** Use `list-modules` instead, which produces richer module summaries (dotted module names, file paths, and complete first-sentence docstring summaries). Migrate templates by replacing `:-: list-features path="..."` with `:-: list-modules path="..."`.
